detect_weight_type: detect the quantized weight type of a PyTorch module or model by scanning for quantized_weight_type attributes
check_and_mark_quantized_module: check a model for quantized layers and mark each detected layer with its quantized_weight_type
convert_module_to_hp_if_necessary: convert quantized FP8 MXFP4 MXFP8 NVFP4 or WOQ layers in a model to high-precision Linear layers
register_weight_type_handler: register a new weight type handler class for a custom ModuleWeightType using the decorator pattern
is_quantized_input_module: check if a model contains quantized input weights and return the detected ModuleWeightType
